title: Nested record pair copy
summary: Recovered bool thiscall at VA 0x490e70 (RVA 0x90e70), size 63. Null nested pointer at owner+0x44 returns false without writes. Otherwise copy nested+0x70 to first output, reload nested, then nested+0x64 to second output, each as ordered 8-byte then 4-byte transfers. Direct caller at 0x5156f3 supplies stack records and consumes the first as floats. No dependencies or calls in the target.
test_description: Compare original thiscall and recovered member on the same arena address after identical initialization: null nested with null outputs, 12 bit-pattern seeds, 14x14 destination combinations including unaligned, shared, overlapping and source-aliasing destinations, plus first output overwriting owner+0x44 with a valid alternate nested pointer. Compare bool and every arena byte, including untouched fields and guards. 2365 cases total.
known_limits: Record semantic names and full owner/nested types remain unresolved; data is copied as opaque bits.
Valid accessible storage required on non-null path; invalid pointers, faults and concurrent mutation are not tested.
Original ABI and layout are i386; native wider-pointer ports retain field meaning rather than the original whole-object binary layout.
No matching-byte claim; ordered byte snapshots express original overlapping-copy behavior in portable C++.
